note: Research collectors: the curated reading trails (seed collections) and the scripts that keep the two knowledge graphs fresh. Trails reference work ids in data/rl_landscape.json (rl:*) and data/sl_landscape.json (sl:*); tools/collect_research.py validates every reference. Script collectors never mutate data/*.json without an explicit --apply flag.

trails.label: RL foundations trail
trails.blurb: The six works to read before any RL opinion: Bellman recursion, TD, Q-learning, REINFORCE, the textbook, and the safety agenda.

trails.label: Deep RL trail
trails.blurb: From pixels to policies: DQN, A3C, TRPO/PPO, Rainbow, SAC/TD3, AlphaGo, MuZero, Dreamer and evolution strategies.

trails.label: Offline RL trail
trails.blurb: Learning from fixed logs: conservatism (CQL), in-sample values (IQL), and RL as sequence modelling.

trails.label: LLM RL trail (RLHF to RLVR)
trails.blurb: Preference learning to verifiable rewards: the Christiano template, InstructGPT, Constitutional AI, DPO, DeepSeek-R1 — read against the lab's continual-learning protocol.

trails.label: Memory-policy RL trail
trails.blurb: Where RL meets the memory store: A-MEM's operators, MemRL's runtime RL, ReasoningBank's compounding bank — the interlink heart of the two graphs.

trails.label: Verbal RL trail
trails.blurb: The update is prose: Reflexion, Voyager's skill library, GEPA's program evolution, Generative Agents — optimisation without gradients.

trails.label: Evaluation discipline trail
trails.blurb: How to tell learning from gaming: hold-outs, bands, sweeps, and the benchmarks both graphs grade on.

collectors.label: Self-learning snapshot sync
collectors.schedule: on lab checkout change; verified by npm test

collectors.schedule: manual; inbox triage before any graph edit
